safety.scope: Hand-authored proposal mutation regression. No adversarial LLM inference, independent attack holdout or comprehensive injection-resistance claim.

representation.scope: Group-disjoint synthetic structured-feature retrieval; shared generator templates remain. Labels used only for retrieval scoring. Similarity never authorizes a task.

training.limitations: Synthetic structured-status representations; no image encoder, pretrained semantics or clinical validation.

rl.scope: Toy MDP learning and shield ablation. State categories overlap training; not clinical task generalization. Hard-coded shield and rule baseline may solve this task without learning.

rows.evaluation_scope: New rollouts of the same toy MDP, not unseen clinical tasks or generalization to new state types.
